title: userspace tests for asymmetric chardev ops (RSA, ECDH, ECDSA)
description:
Write userspace test programs exercising DO_SIGN, DO_VERIFY, DO_AGREE via /dev/crypto2dev for the new asymmetric providers.

## Why this exists
The kernel test modules (test_akcipher.c, test_kpp.c) test wolfcrypt.ko's kernel crypto API registrations. These tests exercise the /dev/crypto2dev chardev path using the same KAT vectors.

## Tests to write
  tests/userspace/test_rsa_chardev.c or test_rsa.c:
    - open /dev/crypto2dev
    - write PKCS#8 private key bytes (from tests/vectors/rsa.h rsa2048_priv_der)
    - KEY_IMPORT ioctl (algo='rsa-2048', key_type=PRIVATE)
    - DO_SIGN with rsa2048_test_digest → compare to rsa2048_test_sig
    - KEY_IMPORT public key → DO_VERIFY → expect 0
    - Tampered sig → DO_VERIFY → expect -EBADMSG

  tests/userspace/test_ecdh_chardev.c or test_ecdh.c:
    - KEY_IMPORT A_priv (ecdh_a_priv_der from tests/vectors/ecdh.h)
    - DO_AGREE with B_pub (ecdh_b_raw_pub), no salt/info → compare OKM prefix (HKDF deterministic)
    - Note: HKDF output is deterministic for fixed inputs, so KAT is possible

  tests/userspace/test_ecdsa_chardev.c or test_ecdsa.c:
    - KEY_IMPORT private → DO_SIGN → KEY_IMPORT public → DO_VERIFY → 0
    - DO_VERIFY with tampered sig → -EBADMSG
    - DO_VERIFY with NIST FIPS 186-4 known ECDSA-P256 vector → 0

## Infrastructure
  All three tests should follow the pattern of tests/userspace/test_chardev.c
  Check for STUB MODE warning in /proc/crypto2dev or dmesg before running
  Return non-zero exit code on any failure (for CI script detection)

## Vectors
  RSA: already in tests/vectors/rsa.h
  ECDH: already in tests/vectors/ecdh.h and ecdh_p384.h
  ECDSA: need NIST FIPS 186-4 P-256 sign/verify known-answer vector (generate with OpenSSL or use NIST ACVP vectors)
acceptance_criteria: All three test programs pass on an AWS instance with libwolfssl.ko + crypto2dev.ko + crypto2dev_wolfssl.ko loaded; exit 0; no STUB MODE
close_reason: test_asym.c written with RSA sign/verify, ECDH agree+KAT, ECDSA sign/verify; ecdsa.h and ecdh HKDF OKM vectors added; compiles clean
